assessment: The four independently reproduced defects can be repaired within the original eight Desktop/client paths. This authorizes no SourceCore, Native3, public schema, CLI, first-use repair, Canon or test-threshold expansion. No new candidate exists in this assessment and the old REQUEST_CHANGES decision is unchanged.

repair_contract.required_outcome: Only explicit human approval in a privileged main-process confirmation of the exact prepared result can consume and send CONFIRM_CODING.
requirements: Renderer invocation is only a request to open the privileged confirmation. A renderer boolean, window.confirm, button click, forged request id/hash, or same-origin IPC call cannot itself authorize the private CONFIRM.

Construct an immutable canonical review snapshot from the validated original main-held request, not from mutable form fields or a new renderer body: original host/data-root/process identity, project/session/current model/workspace binding, current client/writer/revisions, exact read/write paths, check package/pattern/source files, all bounded limits, chosen Go/vendor resource identities and frozen check hashes.

Present a human-readable native dialog owned by the initiating Desktop window. Show the actual trusted workspace identity/description and frozen path/check/limit/resource scope, including absence of vendor. Do not display credentials, tokens or raw protocol JSON. If trusted workspace description is unavailable, block confirmation rather than invent a path or accept a renderer-supplied identity.

Cancel, close, dialog failure and unavailable privileged-confirm capability must send zero CONFIRM/configuration/model/tool effects. Cancellation must preserve the original unconsumed intent for explicit later action while valid.

Do not mark confirmSent or consume the original intent until explicit approval and all post-dialog guards succeed. Then set consumed before the single private write; never auto replay on timeout, rejected reply, remount or second IPC.

After every asynchronous dialog or scope-refresh boundary, reobserve the original trusted host/control/parent identity and current project/session/model/writer/revision/resource generation. Host/session/writer/resource changes or expiry invalidate that approval without dropping the original request.

Prevent parallel privileged confirmations and preserve the one shared coding/qualification/SHUTDOWN command barrier while consent is open. Do not overwrite or forge the protocol pending record to represent a dialog.
acceptance_cases: Direct same-origin codingConfirm IPC without native acceptance sends zero CONFIRM.
Privileged cancel/close/error sends zero CONFIRM and leaves original intent unconsumed.
Explicit accept of unchanged exact frozen scope sends one original CONFIRM.
Changing host/session/writer/model/head revision/resource choice or expiry while dialog is open sends zero CONFIRM and retains original state.
Duplicate confirm requests and coding/qualification/shutdown overlap cannot send a second private write.

repair_contract.required_outcome: No coding or qualification intent is retired or replaced while any shared private command is pending or uncertain.
requirements: Apply the shared pending/uncertain guard before all retirement, history insertion, active-intent clearing, scope/resource replacement or new operation dispatch.

Coding retirement requires the original validated unconsumed request, authoritative original EXPIRED STATUS, actual expiry, fresh same-host identity and no outstanding shared command. Missing proof or a consumed CONFIRM cannot be treated as an empty/new intent.

Preserve the active original request and private message correlation through timeout and late terminal delivery. Process the original terminal before reevaluating retirement; never let a stale continuation clear or overwrite a later intent.

A failed new PREPARE due to pending state must leave active coding/qualification intent and audit unchanged. Keep coding, qualification and SHUTDOWN behind the same barrier; do not add a bypass channel or second coordinator.

Retire completed qualification only from authoritative completed original evidence matching original host/model/session and the explicit coding commit. Never retire pending, uncertain, consumed-but-unproven or stale mismatched qualification.
acceptance_cases: Replay the original real-expiry + confirmed EXPIRED + pending second STATUS counterexample: attempted new PREPARE must keep the exact active id/hash and history unchanged.
Repeat while STATUS has actually timed out; no new private write or retirement.
Deliver the late original terminal, then prove original STATUS/recovery still works and an independently valid retirement can occur later.
Exercise cross-operation coding/qualification/SHUTDOWN overlap and consumed uncertainty; no lost original state or barrier relaxation.

repair_contract.required_outcome: A context change cannot orphan an original PREPARE operation or its valid returned request.
requirements: Retain an original operation record before dispatch, with original host/context/resource bindings and message correlation independent of renderer lifetime.

Validate and retain the original response/request id/hash even when the current UI selection is no longer eligible to use it. Surface a blocked context state; do not throw away the response before storage.

Host-identity failure or malformed/mismatched private response must not be promoted to authorization. Preserve an unresolved/quarantined original operation and recover only through the original trusted host and explicit status policy.

Returning to the original allowed selection must permit original STATUS/recovery, not a silent second PREPARE. Confirm remains forbidden if writer/revision/resource/expiry no longer matches, even if project/session names are the same.
Remount, changed generation and late response must not substitute the current session for the original operation or clear an already retained newer result.
acceptance_cases: Hold PREPARE result, switch session, release result, return to original session: original id/hash and scope remain recoverable and PREPARE frame count stays one.
Repeat with writer/generation/host changes and verify blocked state rather than orphaning or current-session adoption.
Late replies cannot overwrite a newer request; consumed original requests remain non-replayable.

repair_contract.required_outcome: The first authoritative original CODING_CONFIGURED result, whether from CONFIRM or STATUS, reconciles the original V2 views once without another CONFIRM.
requirements: Deduplicate reconciliation by the original commit and its trusted host/project/session/new model reference/revision, not by whether the last UI action was named codingConfirm.

For a successful unchanged-generation recovery, notify/read/adopt the original V2 session/configuration exactly once. Repeated STATUS, duplicate terminal delivery and component remount must not duplicate the successful commit notification.

Use only existing original V2 reads to obtain current authoritative session/configuration. Private CODING_CONFIGURED may trigger refresh but cannot invent a session snapshot, writer lease, authorization or qualification result.
Recheck host/context/generation across every awaited refresh; a result for another selected session remains historical/blocked and cannot update the current view.

Coalesce any in-flight refresh for that commit. If a read/refresh fails, preserve a recoverable refresh-needed state and allow safe explicit read retry without marking an incomplete adoption successful or resending CONFIRM.
Runtime remains REGISTERED after coding commit, qualification remains separately explicit and bounded to one MODEL/zero TOOL. Refresh cannot auto qualify or execute tools.
acceptance_cases: Replay lost CONFIRM reply then STATUS CODING_CONFIGURED in actual DOM: CONFIRM count one, successful onConfigured/V2 reconciliation count one, correct original new model displayed.
Repeat STATUS and remount: no extra successful notification or CONFIRM.
Switch selection/host during STATUS or V2 refresh: do not refresh/adopt into the new selection.
Refresh failure followed by explicit safe retry keeps original commit and does not repeat configuration or model actions.

non_regression_requirements: Keep native directory selection explicit, absolute Go/vendor authority in main, and renderer input restricted to relative path/check/limit intent. Changed resource choice invalidates old consent rather than changing the frozen request silently.
Preserve existing qualification uncertainty/consumed/current-host repairs and bounded private 8 KiB startup diagnostics; no renderer raw stderr/credentials.

Keep original public/Native3/private wire contracts and Core behavior unchanged. Reuse the same inherited management pipe; no second coordinator, auto replay, auto bootstrap, authority downgrade or relaxed body/schema validation.

The repair base is the complete frozen eb7 candidate. Do not import Root current first-use fixes or overwrite them during later integration. Overlapping files such as main.js remain limited to coding repair hunks; parent performs separate integration review.
The accidental empty sibling directory from the prior reviewer operation and blocked caches are outside the source repair and must not be bundled as product changes.
evidence_required_for_next_review: New clean candidate commit on the exact eb7 base with changed paths a subset of the original eight; enumerate all exact source hashes and preserve prior failures.

Meaningful independent causal assertions for all four original counterexamples plus consent cancellation/context races, cross-operation shared barriers and committed-status reconciliation; zero-assertion or skipped cases cannot count as accepted.
Fresh full source-bound Desktop build after causal fixtures stabilize, complete input inventory/digest and drift check, exact bound production module and UI asset provenance.

Actual bound React DOM for the repaired STATUS recovery path and privileged confirmation tests using a controlled main dialog adapter; source/fixture tests must not be relabeled as real native coding or model qualification.
Separate no-install/installed/native first-use limitations remain explicit. Parent host.status and Native3 chooser blockers are outside this repair and cannot be cleared by these client fixtures.
scope_expansion_policy: No additional source path or frozen-contract change is implied. If implementation cannot meet this contract within the eight paths, identify the concrete missing dependency/path before editing outside scope.
current_candidate_acceptance: NOT_GRANTED; old eb7 remains REQUEST_CHANGES and repair requires a new independent review.
writes: Only this separate new scope-assessment directory; prior 44-file receipt manifest/report and source remain frozen.
